text:
tara_pm: quick sync — we need to finalize the chat-completions shape before eng sprint. main conflict: message-array (roles) vs single prompt alias for simplicity. thoughts?

jon_eng: leaning towards message-array as canonical. preserves role semantics and is best for tools/function calling.

maria_ml: +1. message-array maps directly to our context windows and system/user separation which helps evals.

alex_prod: customers keep asking for a simple "prompt" path (one string) for quick porting from old completions. can we support both without exploding surface area?

sam_backend: technically we can accept both. implementation options: 1) accept message array only; provide client-side SDK helper to convert single prompt -> messages, or 2) accept either, normalize server-side to messages.

jon_eng: server-side normalization is easiest for uptake but increases parsing/compatibility tests. need to be careful with system role precedence when prompt + messages both provided.

maria_ml: critical: system role must be deterministic. customers rely on system messages for safety & instruction tuning. proposal: if multiple system messages exist, concatenate with a clear ordering (root system first, then appended ones) and emit a warning in response metadata.

alex_prod: what about assistant role appearing in inputs? some users paste previous assistant outputs into history to correct hallucinations. should we accept assistant as input role?

jon_eng: we can accept assistant role as part of history. but do not allow assistant messages to contain function call objects. function-calling should only be in outputs.

sam_backend: note: function-calling interacts with message shape — we must keep the "role" enum stable for rollout. do not add new roles without migration plan.

maria_ml: streaming & structured output: we need to make sure our proto supports partial JSON schema validation for streaming structured responses (e.g., type hints then full JSON). recommend explicit structured_output schema field in request.

alex_prod: launch criteria suggestion: beta feature that supports both prompt and messages, with message-array as canonical in docs; SDK helpers to convert prompt -> messages; telemetry on which path customers use.

tara_pm: customer asks: enterprise X wants guaranteed system dominance (customer system overrides templates). they want explicit precedence control. how to expose?

jon_eng: add an optional flag `system_precedence` with values `server` or `client` is risky. better: server enforces precedence: explicit `system` in request wins, but allow metadata `merge_system=true|false` to control concatenation behavior. keep it simple.

maria_ml: also add a validation hook: if system messages contradict guardrails, flag for review. we should plug that into Optimize/regression alerts.

sam_backend: rollout plan: feature flag on API layer -> 2-week internal dogfood -> opt-in for top 10 customers -> default on after 6 weeks. need migration docs and SDK patch.

alex_prod: docs + migration checklist: 1) examples for messages array 2) single prompt alias examples 3) sample conversion snippet in JS/Python 4) compatibility notes on assistant-role inputs 5) function-calling caveats 6) guidance on system message concatenation.

tara_pm: acceptance criteria for launch: all unit/integration tests green; SDK helpers published; telemetry capturing path; migration doc and 3 customer-facing examples; sign-off from security on system precedence behavior.

jon_eng: small config snippet we'll implement in server parsing: 
``` 
// pseudocode request normalization 
if (request.prompt) { 
  messages = [{"role": "system", "content": default_system}, {"role": "user", "content": request.prompt}] 
} 
messages = messages.concat(request.messages || []) 
// collapse multiple system messages into one if merge_system=false 
```

maria_ml: also log a `role_shape` event with fields: path_used: ["prompt"|"messages"], system_count, assistant_in_input: true|false. this will help product decide default later.

sam_backend: security note: ensure KMS/HSM flow and PI scrubbers run before any server-side normalization. do not log sensitive prompt content. log counters/hashes only.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature-flagged chat-shape-normalizer -> staging at 2026-04-12T03:00:00Z.

alex_prod: open questions for next sync: do we allow multiple `system` messages by design, or recommend single system and use metadata for templating? also how do we present warnings to clients (headers vs response body).

tara_pm: let's ship with: support both input shapes, message-array canonical, server normalizes prompt->messages, concatenate system messages with clear ordering and optional merge flag, assistant role accepted in history, function-calls only produced by model. create PRD & migration guide. I'll draft PRD today and tag owners. :+1:

jon_eng: i'll start parsing work and tests.

maria_ml: i'll add eval testcases for system precedence and structured output streaming.

sam_backend: i'll own telemetry and feature flag rollout.

alex_prod: I'll own docs and examples.

tara_pm: thanks team — will share PRD link in this thread when ready.
